sections.title: SECTION 1: MATCH EACH DEFINITION ON THE LEFT (1-5) WITH THE CORRECT WORD FROM THE LIST ON THE RIGHT. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: something that is hard to do or overcome
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: difficulty = something that is hard to do or overcome

questions.text: a person that you work with, especially in a profession or business
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): colleague = 同僚

questions.text: something that you do often and regularly, sometimes without thinking about it
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): habit = 習慣・癖

questions.text: a list of things to be done each day, week, or month
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: schedule = a list of things to be done each day, week, or month

questions.text: to give something to someone and receive something in return
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): swap = 交換する

questions.text: something important that is happening
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: event = something important that is happening

questions.text: to be unable to remember
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: forget = to be unable to remember

questions.text: unable to be found
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: lost = unable to be found

questions.text: how heavy a person or thing is
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: weight = how heavy a person or thing is

questions.text: to increase in size or number
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: gain = to increase in size or number

questions.text: to appear a certain way
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24) Ex.2: seem = to appear a certain way

questions.text: a task or situation that tests someone's abilities
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): challenge = 難題・挑戦

questions.text: to successfully reach a desired goal or result by effort
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): achieve = 達成する

questions.text: the accomplishment of an aim or purpose
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): success = 成功

questions.text: to do something enjoyable for an important occasion
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): celebrate = 祝う

questions.text: a purpose or intention; a desired outcome
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): aim = 目的・狙い

questions.text: a possibility of something happening
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20): chance = 可能性・機会

questions.text: a physical path or the way in which a project is developing
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20) NOTE: direction = 方向・方角

questions.text: something created to use for a short period of time, for a specific purpose
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.21) NOTE: makeshift = 一時しのぎの・間に合わせの

questions.text: feeling worried, uneasy, or nervous about an uncertain event
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): anxious = 不安な・心配して

questions.text: not giving enough attention or thought to avoiding errors or harm
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): careless = 不注意な・うっかりした

questions.text: feeling certainty about your own abilities
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): confident = 自信がある

questions.text: noticeably happy and optimistic
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): cheerful = 陽気な・明るい

questions.text: feeling optimism about a future event
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): hopeful = 希望を持っている

questions.text: unwilling to work or use energy
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): lazy = 怠惰な・面倒くさがりの

questions.text: easily agitated or alarmed; tending to feel worried before an exam
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22): nervous = 緊張している・神経質な

questions.text: to accidentally allow liquid to flow over the edge of its container
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): spill = こぼす

questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): fault = 責任・過失（せい）

questions.text: a very brief period of time
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): moment = 少しの間・瞬間

questions.text: to arrive at a place or destination
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): reach = 到達する・着く

questions.text: after a long time, typically involving difficulty or delay
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26): finally = ついに・ようやく

sections.title: SECTION 2: CHOOSE THE BEST ANSWER TO EACH QUESTION. (5 POINTS)

questions.text: I have a habit of biting my nails when I feel anxious.
choices: Why don't you try chewing gum instead?
Why don't you try biting them harder?
Why don't you try to be lazy instead?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22) Focus: 緊張や不安時の癖に対する代替行動のアドバイスとして「Why don't you try chewing gum instead?」が適切。

questions.text: Which of the following sentences is punctuated correctly?
choices: When I have a big test coming up I feel nervous.
When I have a big test coming up, I feel nervous.
I feel nervous, when I have a big test coming up.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.23) Grammar: when節が主節の前に来る場合は、when節の直後にカンマを置きます。

questions.text: She had difficulty with the test questions because she _________ for the exam.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.24-25): 過去の困難（had difficulty）より前に勉強していなかったことを表すため、過去完了（hadn't studied）を使います。

questions.text: When he arrived at the office, he _________ at his schedule.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.7-5: 到着した直後に行動した過去の連続動作には、単純過去形（looked）を使います。

questions.text: We _________ for days when we finally reached the end of the path.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26) Ex.4: 過去の時点（reached）まで一定期間続いていた動作を表すため、過去完了進行形（had been walking）を用います。

questions.text: I have a habit of talking a lot when I'm nervous.
choices: Why don't you try breathing slowly instead?
Why don't you try talking louder instead?
Why don't you try skipping class instead?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22) Focus: 緊張して喋りすぎてしまう癖へのアドバイス「Why don't you try breathing slowly instead?」

questions.text: I have a habit of being lazy when I'm tired.
choices: Why don't you try going to bed earlier?
Why don't you try staying up all night?
Why don't you try forgetting your schedule?
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-B (p.22) Focus: 疲れて怠けてしまう癖へのアドバイス「Why don't you try going to bed earlier?」

questions.text: He felt anxious all day because he _________ to lock his front door.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.7-2: 不安に感じた（felt）より前に鍵を閉め忘れたため、過去完了形 had forgotten を使います。

questions.text: He gained weight because he _________ a lot over the holidays.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.7-3: 体重が増えた（gained）より前にたくさん食べていたため、過去完了形 had eaten を使います。

questions.text: She _________ nervous when she spoke to the interviewer.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-C (p.25) Ex.7-1: 面接官と話した時に同時に緊張したため、単純過去形 felt を使います。

questions.text: I _________ the garbage when the school bell finally rang.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.27) Ex.4-1: ベルが鳴った時点まで続けていた動作を過去完了進行形 had been collecting で表します。

questions.text: Jack _________ to find his schedule for a moment before the meeting began.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.27) Ex.4-3: 会議が始まる前まで続いていた動作を過去完了進行形 had been trying で表します。

questions.text: Petra _________ baseball cards when the ball hit her in the face.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.27) Ex.4-4: ボールが当たるまで続いていた動作を過去完了進行形 had been trading で表します。

questions.text: My teacher _________ before my classmate spilled his juice.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.27) Ex.4-5: クラスメートがジュースをこぼす前まで笑っていたことを過去完了進行形 had been laughing で表します。

questions.text: The thousand-piece puzzle was a _________ to finish. I never put together so many pieces before.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20) Ex.2-1: 1000ピースのパズルを完成させるのは難題（challenge）だった。

questions.text: There is a _________ that the plane will leave later than expected.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20) Ex.2-5: There is a chance that ~（〜という可能性がある）。

questions.text: I'm lost. Can you tell me which _________ to go? I need to get to my math class.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-A (p.20) Ex.2-6: which direction to go（どの方向へ行けばよいか）。

questions.text: Sarah says it isn't her _________ her brother is crying. He is hungry and needs to be fed.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26) Ex.2-3: it isn't her fault（彼女のせいではない）。

questions.text: Let's _________ video games. You lend me Lock & Load, and I'll give you Grand Prix.
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26) Ex.2-7: swap video games（テレビゲームを交換する）。

questions.text: I _________ learned my new colleague's name. I had been calling him Alan instead of Aaron!
questions.explanation: 教科書 Unit 2-D (p.26) Ex.2-8: finally（ついに・ようやく新しい同僚の名前を覚えた）。
